label: Ontology and existence
text: PL.O.A1.1 Ontology and existence. Particular and universal; object and property; tropes; substance; mereology; abstract objects against nominalism. Existence answers: materialism, idealism, dualism, neutral monism. These are answers, not further questions.

warrant.standard: Parsimony and explanatory power argued; replies given
warrant.defeaters: Ideological cost; counterexample; contradicting PH or BI results
